operationKey.description: Your key for this operation: make a new random one for each call (a UUID, for example), 16 to 128 characters of A-Z a-z 0-9 _ . : -. The same key with the same content answers the first result without doing the work again; the same key with other content is REQUEST_CONFLICT. This tool has no session, so the key is shared by every caller of it, and the result is kept for 24 hours.
